both_separate, both_shared, other, not_stated, conflicting.

Evidence: "Table 1 uses parallel platings of samples from the same grown culture to check sampling and plating variability. Table 2 uses cultures grown separately in parallel before testing." In records series: experiment 11a table 1, experiment 11 table 2. Thus 11a uses same grown culture (shared), 11 uses cultures grown separately (separate). That maps to shared_then_separate: 11a samples share one grown culture; 11 samples from cultures grown separately before selection. Yes q1 shared_then_separate.

Question q2: Under source's mutation-and-growth interpretation, what relation can connect distinct resistant cells present at plating? Options:
clonal_descendants: Several resistant cells can descend from one earlier resistance mutation; cell/colony abundance doesn't identify number of origins.
one_origin_per_cell, selection_creates_each_origin, repeated_image, other, not_stated, conflicting.

Evidence: "Under mutation interpretation, resistance can arise before virus exposure and be inherited by descendants. Early mutations can therefore contribute many resistant cells. The paper distinguishes mutation events from their descendants and interprets fluctuations using clonal relatedness. Neither selected table assigns colonies to individual mutation origins." This establishes clonal_descendants. So q2 clonal_descendants.
